configuration.changes: Use frozen parent W24 sources and flags in an independent verification workspace; no quantization, parameter interface, dataset, threshold or parent-workspace changes. Limit per-run placement/routing to 4 threads while synthesis remains single-threaded; preserve the serial hardware lock. Exit Vivado after synthesis/report, then reopen the new project in a fresh process for implementation/report; retain the cumulative three-hour tool timeout and one-heavy scheduling. Change only the implementation clock constraint; preserve parent HLS RTL.
configuration.conclusion: Compare measured frame cycles and implementation timing before selecting the final integration candidate. Review unattended section6 decisions with the user tomorrow.

estimates.basis: Frozen W24 HLS resource/cycle measurements. Full-image C validation preserves arithmetic; RTL includes finite-FIFO/AXI behavior. Physical resources and timing remain unknown until routed reports. No board measurement is inferred. Decision basis: W31 independently closes 5 ns with WNS +0.470 ns, WHS +0.038 ns, no unrouted or partial nets, 630 DSP, 33771 LUT, 82635 FF and 101 BRAM18K. This satisfies the preplanned trigger for a fresh 4.5 ns ROM probe; slack-derived 4.53 ns is not timing closure. Preserve identical W24 RTL and constant coefficient hashes, use fresh staged synthesis/report and implementation/report, synthesis1 and routing4 threads, cumulative3h timeout, one heavy task, 18 GiB implementation registration and serial_after_oom. Mainline C22/C21 retain queue priority. ROM is exploratory, not a runtime-weight or board replacement.
